key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of dock icons in pixels (16-96)

key.name: magnification-enabled
key.description: Whether icons grow when the pointer hovers near the dock

key.name: magnification-scale
key.description: Maximum scale applied to the icon directly under the cursor (1.0 = no magnification)

key.name: magnification-falloff
key.description: How far (in pixels) the magnification wave reaches from the cursor

key.name: running-indicators
key.description: Show a small dot under icons of running apps

key.name: running-indicator-style
key.description: 0 = dots per window (macOS style), 1 = horizontal bar

key.name: bounce-on-launch
key.description: Play a bounce animation on the dock icon when a new app is launched

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of the show/hide animation in milliseconds (0 = instant, max 1000)

key.name: magnification-framerate
key.description: Target framerate for magnification animation in Hz (30, 60, or 120)

key.name: icon-quality
key.description: Render icons at N times native resolution to prevent blur when magnified (1, 2, or 4)

key.name: show-threshold
key.description: Distance in pixels from screen edge to trigger dock show

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Dock background opacity percentage (0-100)

key.name: dock-background-color
key.description: Hex color for dock background (e.g. #1e1e1e)

key.name: dock-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the dock in pixels

key.name: dock-blur-enabled
key.description: Apply blur effect behind the dock for a frosted glass look

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Position of the dock on screen (0=bottom, 1=left, 2=right, 3=top)

key.name: show-applications-button
key.description: Show a button to access all installed applications

key.name: window-previews
key.description: Show live thumbnail previews of app windows on hover

key.name: preview-scale
key.description: Width of each preview thumbnail in pixels (100-400)

key.name: show-running-apps
key.description: Show non-favorite running applications in the dock

key.name: dock-workspace-mode
key.description: Which workspaces show running apps (0=all, 1=current only)

key.name: media-controls
key.description: Show play/pause controls in the dock context menu when media is playing

key.name: media-indicator
key.description: Show a music note indicator on the icon of the currently playing media app

key.name: icons-fix-enabled
key.description: Keep non-favorite running apps in the dock across minimize and workspace switches

key.name: dodge-enabled
key.description: Keep the dock visible unless the focused window overlaps it

key.name: dodge-only-focused
key.description: Hide only when the currently focused window overlaps the dock; otherwise any overlapping window hides it

key.name: peek-edge-px
key.description: Pointer must be within this many pixels of the screen edge to peek the hidden dock

key.name: peek-hold-ms
key.description: Pointer must stay inside the deep zone this long before the hidden dock peeks out

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.description: Force-hide the dock and disable peeking while a true fullscreen window is on the active workspace

key.name: keynav-enabled
key.description: Super+1..9 / Super+0 cycles the nth app in the dock: launch if not running, raise if running but unfocused, minimize if focused

key.name: keynav-app-1
key.description: Activate the first app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-2
key.description: Activate the second app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-3
key.description: Activate the third app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-4
key.description: Activate the fourth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-5
key.description: Activate the fifth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-6
key.description: Activate the sixth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-7
key.description: Activate the seventh app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-8
key.description: Activate the eighth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-9
key.description: Activate the ninth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-app-10
key.description: Activate the tenth app in the dock

key.name: keynav-peek-dock
key.summary: Pop up the dock on Super+number
key.description: Briefly reveal a dodge-hidden dock whenever a Super+number shortcut fires, whether it launches, focuses, switches or minimizes

key.name: keynav-peek-duration
key.description: How long the dock stays revealed after a Super+number shortcut

key.name: keynav-stock-backup
key.description: Internal crash-recovery backup of org.gnome.shell.keybindings switch-to-application-1..9, one newline-joined entry per slot, taken when the dock grabs them. Not user-facing; never shown in preferences.

key.name: keynav-stock-dirty
key.summary: Internal: stock keybinding grab dirty flag
key.description: True while the dock holds cleared stock keybindings. Lets the next enable() self-heal after a crash between grab and restore. Not user-facing; never shown in preferences.

key.name: genie-enabled
key.description: Play the macOS genie animation when a window minimizes into, or restores out of, its dock icon

key.name: genie-peek-hidden-dock
key.summary: Peek the hidden dock during the animation
key.description: When the dock is hidden by dodge, briefly show it during a minimize/restore so the window can be seen flying to its icon. When off, the animation flies to the screen's bottom edge instead

key.name: genie-minimize-duration
key.description: How long the window takes to pour into its dock icon

key.name: genie-restore-duration
key.description: How long the window takes to stream back out of its dock icon

key.name: genie-curvature
key.description: 0 = gentle macOS S-curve, 1 = tighter KDE magic-lamp gather

key.name: genie-lead-fraction
key.description: Fraction of the animation after which the near edge has reached the icon

key.name: genie-trail-fraction
key.description: Fraction of the animation at which the far edge starts to move

key.name: genie-absorb-depth
key.description: How deep into the icon the window sinks at the end (fraction of icon depth)

key.name: genie-tail-fade
key.description: Final fraction of the animation over which the last sliver fades out

key.name: genie-mesh-resolution
key.description: Upper bound on the number of strips along the funnel; the actual count adapts to the window size (higher = smoother curves)
